title: Graduate with Family, UCLA Campus Arches - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot dated February 1966 depicting a young female university graduate clad in a traditional black academic cap and gown with a corsage pinned to her robe. She holds a wrapped gift while speaking with two proudly supportive older women, likely her mother and grandmother, who are dressed in mid-century coats and styled hair. They stand outside an arched, Romanesque-style brick campus building, reminiscent of Royce Hall at UCLA.
